guest.bio_context: Ketch Secor has been in Old Crow Medicine Show for 28 years. His parents were educators who founded schools, inspiring him to start an Episcopal nonprofit school in Nashville that is now in its 11th year with 150 students. He funded the school's early years using earnings from his music career, particularly from work with Darius Rucker, while simultaneously touring extensively with the band.
